Similarly for humidity: same location.

For precipitation: location "Rome, Italy".

Thus we will first call weather_forecast_temperature with location "Boston, USA", days 10. Then call weather_forecast_humidity with same. Then call weather_forecast_precipitation with location "Rome, Italy", days 10.

After receiving all three responses, we will combine them into a single answer.
